devdoc.details: A contract to manage an administrative whitelist, allowing entities to bypass Keyring credential checks.

params.account: The address of the unauthorized account.

params.newAdmin: The address of the new admin.
params.oldAdmin: The address of the previous admin.

params.entity: The address of the entity whose whitelist status was updated.
params.status: The new whitelist status of the entity (true if whitelisted, false otherwise).

changeAdmin(address).details: Only callable by the current admin. Emits an {AdminChange} event.

params.newAdmin: The address of the new admin.

params.entity: The address of the entity being checked.
params.policyId: The ID of the policy to check against.

returns._0: bool True if the entity is whitelisted or meets the policy's credentials; otherwise, false.

params.keyring_: The address of the Keyring contract.

setWhitelistStatus(address,bool).details: Only callable by the current admin. Emits a {Whitelist} event if status changes.

params.entity: The address of the entity whose whitelist status is to be updated.
params.status: The new whitelist status (true to whitelist, false to remove from whitelist).

devdoc.title: KeyringIdleWhitelist

NotAdmin(address).notice: Error thrown when an unauthorized account attempts to perform an admin-only action.

AdminChange(address,address).notice: Emitted when the admin address is changed.

Whitelist(address,bool).notice: Emitted when an entity's whitelist status is updated.

admin().notice: The address of the current admin with permission to manage the whitelist and change admin.

changeAdmin(address).notice: Updates the admin of the contract to a new address.

checkCredential(uint256,address).notice: Checks if an entity meets a policy's credentials or is whitelisted.

constructor.notice: Initializes the contract with the Keyring contract address and sets the deployer as the admin.

keyring().notice: The address of the deployed Keyring contract.

setWhitelistStatus(address,bool).notice: Sets or updates the whitelist status of a given entity.

whitelist(address).notice: Mapping to track whitelist status of entities (true if whitelisted, false otherwise).
